name: precedent-shared-ladder
subject: the five-stage ladder -- Consider, Act, Booked, Debut, Produce -- and the branch tiers it climbs, for the people who bring it
_provides_comment: The capability this set gives the person who brings it (spec/LADDER_OPT_IN_PLAN.md in BestPractice). The engine says the ladder is in force for a person only when a set providing it is loaded, and PRECEDENT_NO_LADDERS=1 drops it.

patterns.kind: a ladder command, quoted or bold
patterns.regex: (?:\*\*|["“])(?:Booked|Book it|Go update|Brainstorm|Plan it|Write it up|Debut|Make live|Promote(?: \d)?)(?:\*\*|["”])

_owned_words_comment: This set's own words: the engine's set-words-stay-in-their-set check holds every other set, template and person-facing document to them, and engine tests hold printed output to them off the ladder (BestPractice spec/ENFORCEMENT_LIVES_WITH_ITS_PRACTICE_PLAN.md part 3, 2026-10-17; moved out of the engine unchanged). STRICT words only: Consider, Act and Produce are ordinary English and never match alone; a stage counts only beside its step label, a command only quoted, bold or capitalised as a command. Each pattern's matches and never_matches are run by that check, so they are this set's tests of its own words.
_step_review_comment: The tool BestPractice's engine calls to review what a step met -- at Update Vendors, and at Booked, Debut and Produce -- for a code owner on the ladder (practices/upstream-review.md). The engine knows the point and the interface (prepare, report, trailer_lines, TRAILER), never the rule; it moved here from the engine's precedent_upstream_review.py on 2026-10-17.
_occasion_share_comment: This set's allowance in the occasion index of every person who brings it. Carved out of the universal set's on 2026-10-02 (BestPractice spec/LADDER_OPT_IN_PLAN.md D15, Morgan, strength: decided): universal went from 2,800 to 2,250 as these rules left it, so a person who brings this set loads no more than before. Measured about 450 that day.
_comment: This file is what makes the directory a practice-set source: its
name is chosen once, here, and every consumer declares it verbatim.
The repository holding it may be called anything. `subject` is a
sentence saying what the set is about; `code` lists directories
a consumer vendors alongside the practices (tools/, for a set
whose practices are about a tool it ships).
